waivers.verdict: Nothing to claim. The free-agent pool is open first-come-first-serve right now (post-Wednesday-run window), and nothing on it clears the bar for a roster spot I don't have — bench is full and the only open question (TE) is a lineup call, not a waiver one.

lineup.verdict: Put Brock Bowers back in at TE and bench Mike Gesicki. Bowers is still only Questionable, not downgraded further, and he's well clear of Gesicki on the numbers, the matchup, and recent usage.

trades.verdict: Hold. The trade deadline (Week 11) passed last week — no trade can be made for the rest of the season.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable. No NFL games are being played today — the next kickoffs are Sunday. Nothing to check or pivot yet.
